name: UPSC Civil Services Examination
summary: India's national-level exam for recruitment to IAS, IPS, IFS, and other central civil services, conducted in three stages: Preliminary, Main, and Interview.
eligibility: Indian citizen (with specific relaxations for other categories for select services)
Age 21-32 years as of 1 August of the exam year (upper limit relaxed for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/other reserved categories)
Bachelor's degree from a recognised university (final-year students can apply provisionally)
Maximum of 6 attempts for General category (relaxed for reserved categories)
documents: Recent photograph and signature (digital, as per specification)
Valid photo ID for exam day
fee: ₹100 for General/OBC/EWS male candidates; exempted for women, SC/ST, and PwBD candidates.
process: Apply online via the One Time Registration (OTR) and application module
Qualified candidates appear for the Main Examination (9 descriptive papers)
Qualified candidates attend the Personality Test (Interview)
Final merit list and service allocation released

faq.question: How many stages does the UPSC CSE have?
faq.answer: Three: Preliminary (screening, objective type), Main (descriptive, 9 papers), and the Personality Test (interview). Only Prelims marks are used for qualifying; Main + Interview marks determine the final rank.

faq.question: How many attempts are allowed?
faq.answer: General category candidates get 6 attempts up to age 32. OBC candidates get 9 attempts up to age 35. SC/ST candidates have unlimited attempts up to age 37. PwBD relaxations apply on top of category limits.
